title: Independent reading: Acts 17:16–34
subtitle: Follow public address, quotation, and inference.
overview: Paul’s Areopagus address moves from observation to claim, citation, correction, and summons. Map the argumentative turns before evaluating any one statement.
Quotation and allusion are embedded in the speech. Mark their boundaries and ask how they serve the speaker’s immediate argument.

items.grc: ὃ οὖν ἀγνοοῦντες εὐσεβεῖτε, τοῦτο ἐγὼ καταγγέλλω ὑμῖν.
items.en: What therefore you worship in ignorance, this I proclaim to you.
For we are also his offspring.
